stem:
A teacher has a container of paper clips. She will randomly select one paper clip from the container.

• The container has 8 pink paper clips.
• The container has 14 purple paper clips.
• The container has 12 yellow paper clips.
• The container has 16 blue paper clips.

Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The probability of selecting a purple paper clip is \( \frac{3}{4} \), and the probability of selecting a paper clip that is not purple is \( \frac{1}{4} \).

options.label: B
options.text: The probability of selecting a purple paper clip is \( \frac{1}{4} \), and the probability of selecting a paper clip that is not purple is \( \frac{3}{4} \).

options.label: C
options.text: The probability of selecting a purple paper clip is \( \frac{18}{25} \), and the probability of selecting a paper clip that is not purple is \( \frac{7}{25} \).

options.label: D
options.text: The probability of selecting a purple paper clip is \( \frac{7}{25} \), and the probability of selecting a paper clip that is not purple is \( \frac{18}{25} \).
